heading: Settings manager
intro: Each agent merges its own settings files, in the order it merges them. Claude Code’s are edited here; the rest are read as written.
projectHint: Pick a project in the sidebar to edit its own settings and its local overrides.
noScope: No settings file for this scope
unreadable: This file is not valid JSON. Fix it by hand before editing here.
permissionHint_allow: Tools that run without a prompt.
permissionHint_deny: Tools refused outright, whatever else allows them.
permissionHint_ask: Tools that always ask, even when another rule allows them.
permissionHint_additionalDirectories: Folders outside the project that Claude Code may read.
envHint: Set for every session Claude Code starts in this scope.
readOnlyHint: This agent keeps its own settings schema, so it is read as written rather than edited. Change it in the file itself.
holdsNothing: This file has no settings in it yet.
noSettingsFile: This agent has no settings file of its own. Its MCP servers and rules are read in Health.
